changes: Explicit canned-corned-beef lapskojs: new 680 g whole prepared product (two 340 g cans) replaces 700 g raw cured brisket, not a cooking-yield conversion. Remove the unnecessary 150-minute raw-meat braise. Cook onion with potato, retain all canned fat/jelly and milk/butter. Weigh roots after raw peeling; discarded cooking water has unknown retention. Separate beet draining/dressing and potato inspection from passive simmering.
recipes.content_review: Finfördelat saltat nötkött arbetas in i grovt potatismos; uttrycklig konservversion, skild från skivat kött med mos, stekt biffpanna och rimmad lägg med rotmos.
